questions.text: What is the first step when you discover a fire in the building?
choices: Try to put it out yourself
questions.explain: Always raise the alarm first so others can evacuate. Only attempt to fight a fire if you are trained and it is safe.

questions.text: When should you report a near-miss incident?
choices: As soon as practical, even if no one was hurt
questions.explain: Near-misses reveal hazards before they cause harm. Report them promptly so controls can be improved.

questions.text: If you see a spill of unknown liquid, you should:
choices: Clean it with paper towels immediately
Ignore it if it is small
Secure the area and report it to the appropriate team
Pour water on it to dilute it
questions.explain: Unknown liquids may be hazardous. Isolate the area and get trained responders involved.
